offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures specialty municipal vehicles such as street sweepers and vacuum excavators, plus sirens, warning lights and public safety communication systems. Sells mainly to municipalities, public works agencies, police and fire departments, utilities and contractors, through direct sales and dealers.

primary_products.value: street sweepers; vacuum excavators; sirens and warning lights; public safety communication systems; aerial platforms

primary_services.value: parts and aftermarket service; equipment rental

customer_segment.value: B2G: municipalities, public works departments, police and fire agencies, school districts; B2B: contractors, utilities, airports and industrial facilities

end_markets.value: municipal public works; public safety; utilities and contractors; industrial; airports

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty vehicles, sirens, warning lights and communication equipment; service fees: replacement parts, aftermarket service and maintenance

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds vehicles and safety equipment from purchased components, sold to municipalities and contractors

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some sales in Europe, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: environmental solutions vehicles and equipment, safety and security systems such as sirens, lights and communications, sold to shared municipal customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: municipal and government accounts, utilities and large contractors; distributors / dealers: independent dealers for vehicles and equipment in local markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle safety and emissions standards, and public safety equipment certification rules
